Each targeted encoding was expanded to primitives and compared with the printed words:

(1) amplitude vs "A_g (any g)": `amplitude P hP hn := treeCoefficient P hP 0 hn` (stmt l.36-37). In the ZMod n labelling the source label n is residue 0, and `edge P 0 = P 1 - P 0` runs from μ_n to μ_1, i.e. E_n, so root 0 is the main text's A_n exactly as def:treesum says ("The main text's A(P) is A_n(P), rooted at the last edge E_n from μ_n to μ_1"). Field root_independent (l.42-43) asserts `amplitude P hP.1 hn = treeCoefficient P hP.1 g hn` for every root g on Generic P (= thm:root-indep-proof "for every generic polygon P and any two of its edges g,h, A_g(P)=A_h(P)"); shift_invariant (l.45-46) and descends (l.48-49: ∃ A' : GenericPolygon n → ℤ, A' (polygonProjection P) = amplitude P) render "well defined on generic polygons", with GenericPolygon n = Quotient of {P // Generic P} by the cyclic shift `shift k P i = P (i + k)` (Chambers.lean l.14-21, Polygon.lean l.22) = def:polygon's orbit space. Nothing weaker.

(2) sideTuple true/false vs P_±: `sideTime true t = ⟨t.val,_⟩`, `sideTime false t = ⟨-t.val,_⟩`, `sideTuple b t = ⟨curve (sideTime b t), _⟩` (WallGerm.lean l.34-50). def:germ: "sides P_- and P_+ are the chambers containing P((−ε,0)) and P((0,ε))"; "for a function F constant on chambers, F(P_±) denotes its value on the respective side". The bundle quantifies ∀ s t : SideParameter and uses amplitude at those points, which (with chamber_constant) is the printed value; if anything stronger.

(3) FlatRight/Left: `turn P i = chi P (i-1) i (i+1)` with `chi P i j k = sign det (P j - P i) (P k - P i)`; `turn_det : turn P i = sign det (edge P (i-1)) (edge P i)` = τ_j of lem:flat-sides. flat_law (l.67-68) requires `turn (w.curve sRight) j = -1` and `turn (w.curve sLeft) j = 1` for nonzero parameters, matching thm:A-S3 "P_right is the side with τ_j = −1" and def:walls (F) "The right side is the side with τ_j=−1 and the left side the one with τ_j=+1". Same encoding as the accepted FlatLawTree row (l.30-32). Existence of both sides is the accepted def:walls fact NamedWallsData.flat_sides (∃! b, FlatRightSide j b ∧ FlatLeftSide j (!b)), so the implication form is not vacuous. The deletion `deleteVertex w.center j` (= P(0)∖j: deleteVertex 0 = P(j+1), deleteVertex (-1) = P(j-1), induced cyclic order omitting μ_j) is asserted Generic (extra, lem:children) and its amplitude taken at root 0; by root independence this equals the accepted A_{D_j(g)}(P(0)∖j).

(4) contactSign vs s: `contactSign M a := chi (sideTuple false sideBase).val a (a+1) M` (NamedWallSides.lean l.58-59) = χ_{a,a+1,M}(P_-), exactly thm:A-S7 "s=χ_{a,a+1,M}(P_-)" and def:walls (V) "The contact sign is s=χ_{a,a+1,M}(P_-)". vertex_edge_law (l.101-108): amplitude(sideTuple true t) − amplitude(sideTuple false s) = contactSign * (amplitude λ₁ * amplitude λ₂) = "A(P_+)−A(P_-)=sA(λ₁)A(λ₂)"; Generic halves are extra information (stronger).

(6) softAmplitudeMultiplier vs (χ_-+χ_+)/2: `((softAttachmentMinus : ℤ) : ℚ) + ((softAttachmentPlus : ℤ) : ℚ)) / 2` with softAttachmentMinus = −sign det(edge P (j−1)) q = χ_- and softAttachmentPlus = −sign det q (edge P j) = χ_+ (accepted def:soft row, SoftInsertionDefinition l.41-50). soft_theorem (l.116-121): SoftAdmissible P j q → ∃ ε₁>0, ∀ 0<ε<ε₁, ∃ hQ : Generic (softInsertion P j q ε), (amplitude P_ε : ℚ) = mult * (amplitude P : ℚ); no sector hypothesis, so "in every sector" is covered; the ε₁ ≤ ε₀ clause of thm:A-soft is not in the corollary and genericity of P_ε is supplied directly.
